newsitem.title: UK: Growth funds top Q2 returns for UK private clients.
newsitem.headline: Growth funds top Q2 returns for UK private clients.

text.p: Private client investment portfolios were boosted in the second quarter by strong UK and international equity market performances.

Performance consultancy WM Company said on Monday growth funds were the top performers in the quarter among private client portfolios, due to large weightings in international equities and despite the strength of the pound.
WM's Private Client Indicators showed investors in growth funds could have expected returns of 6.8 percent in the quarter, with income funds returning 5.2 percent and balanced funds 6.1 percent.
The figures were significantly up on the first quarter when returns were 4.8 percent, 3.5 percent and 4.0 percent respectively.
Growth funds showed total returns of 16.2 percent over a rolling 12 month period, against 15 percent for income and 15.8 percent for balanced.
WM said some individual funds showed even higher returns, with some growth funds having over 40 percent of their assets in international equities. The growth fund average was 29 percent.
The proportion invested in North America varied between nil and 15 percent, with opinion divided about the likelihood of a correction in the world's major economy.
WM project manager Lesley Abbott said investors in Japan and the Pacific at last saw a good return after several quarters of disappointing and often negative results.
The private client survey was launched in January 1997 and is based on quarterly information from 25 managers.
